name: Szentimrefalva (Hungary)
description: Three vertical stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentimrefalva (a blue shield with a figure of Saint Emeric, a Hungarian shield and a rose) above the name SZENTIMREFALVA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
